ms.report:
Output 1: Implementation of the Scalable ELT Pipeline
Output:
This submission provides the required proof that Token Terminal successfully implemented and deployed a scalable ELT (Extract–Load–Transform) pipeline for Cardano blockchain data. The pipeline has been running continuously for 85 days (target: ≥7 days), processing both historical and new data from genesis block (1) to the current chain tip (block 13,021,634). Data freshness is maintained at approximately 40 minutes lag from the chain tip (target: ≤60 minutes). The attached report includes the full pipeline architecture, data flow description, run configuration, block processing statistics, uptime verification queries, and incident log confirming zero downtime during the reporting period.
Acceptance criteria:
The ELT pipeline runs continuously for at least 7 days without interruption and processes both historical and new data.
Evidence: ELT Pipeline Implementation

Output 2: Decoded and Normalized Relational Data Tables
Output:
This submission provides the required proof that all historical blocks and transactions have been successfully ingested and normalized into relational tables. The Cardano dataset consists of three core tables — cardano.blocks, cardano.transactions, and cardano.transactions_utxos — stored in Google BigQuery with daily partitioning for query performance. The data covers the full chain history from genesis (block 1) to the current tip, with 100% block completeness, 100% transaction completeness (118,611,898 transactions), and 100% UTXO completeness — all exceeding the ≥98% target. The attached document includes full schema definitions, data mapping descriptions, example rows, table relationships, and query examples demonstrating cross-table joins.

ms.report:
Output 1: Onchain Price Feed Integration

Output:
This submission provides the required proof that Token Terminal has successfully implemented an onchain price feed for Cardano. The price feed integrates data from Minswap V1, V2, and StableSwap — the largest Cardano DEX by TVL (~$50M+). The pipeline consists of 12 production dbt models with dynamic pool discovery: new pools are automatically detected from on-chain UTXO data without any code changes. 2,371 pools have been discovered across all three pool types. Prices are produced at hourly granularity with forward-fill, converging into the unified prices_end_of_day_filtered table used by all downstream metric calculations. The average variance of the Token Terminal ADA price feed vs CoinGecko benchmark over the reporting period is 0.69% — well within the ≤2% acceptance threshold.
Acceptance criteria:
Onchain price feed active and continuously updated in the data warehouse. Average variance between Token Terminal price feed and CoinGecko benchmark within ±2% for top tokens by volume.
Evidence:
Onchain Price Feed Integration
Output 2: Creation of Data Abstractions

Output:
This submission provides the required proof that a Cardano data abstraction layer has been built and deployed. The abstraction layer consists of 5 models across two BigQuery datasets (tt-abstractions.cardano and tt-abstractions.cardano_private), transforming Cardano's UTXO data structure into Token Terminal's standardised cross-chain token flow format — consistent with Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, and other chains. The models include two UTXO fact views (credited/debited), two incremental token flow tables (token_deposits, token_withdraws), and a daily net flow aggregation table (cardano_day_token_net_flows). All tables cover from genesis to current day with 100% coverage, updated daily as part of the nightly pipeline. ms.report:
Output 1: Standardized Metrics Computation

Output:
This submission provides the required proof that Token Terminal has successfully computed all standardised onchain metrics for Cardano. A total of 39 metrics are now live and updating daily (target: 20+), covering the full historical range from Cardano mainnet genesis (2017-09-23) to the current day. All metrics follow Token Terminal's public Layer 1 methodology, documented at https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/metrics, ensuring direct cross-chain comparability with Ethereum, Solana, Bitcoin, and other chains. Key metrics include fees, revenue, fees supply side, token incentives, expenses, earnings, transaction counts, active addresses (DAU/WAU/MAU), tokenholders, block time, TPS, number of validators, staking market cap, contracts deployed, market cap, price, and a full set of derived valuation ratios (P/F, P/S, ARPU, AFPU, token turnover). Variance against on-chain reference data is 0% for fees and transaction counts (exact SUM calculations from the transactions table), well within the ±2% acceptance threshold. Token incentives are sourced from actual epoch reward data via the Koios API.
Acceptance criteria:
Metric definitions and formulas are clearly documented and reviewed by the Milestone Reviewers or Catalyst Team. Calculations are consistent with Token Terminal's established framework for comparable Layer 1 metrics. Variance between Cardano metrics and benchmark reference data within ±2% for key indicators such as transaction counts and active addresses.

ms.report:
This submission provides the required proof of completion for Milestone 5 - going live with onchain analytics coverage for the Cardano ecosystem. It documents three outputs: 
(1) dedicated Token Terminal dashboards for 10 Cardano ecosystem projects, 
(2) aggregated ecosystem metrics added to the main Cardano dashboard, and 
(3) a marketing and distribution campaign that exceeded the 10,000-account reach target and confirmed Cardano data display across multiple Token Terminal distribution partners. 
All dashboards update daily via the automated data pipeline delivered in Milestones 1-4 and follow Token Terminal's public Layer 1 methodology, documented at https://tokenterminal.com/explorer/metrics, ensuring cross-chain comparability with other Layer 1 blockchains.
Output 1: Cardano Ecosystem Dashboard Integrations

Output:
Token Terminal has launched and maintains dedicated dashboards for 10 Cardano ecosystem projects on tokenterminal.com (target: 10+), each displaying standardized onchain metrics including active addresses, transaction counts, and gas used. Project selection prioritized the Cardano applications with the highest transaction activity and gas usage, spanning DEXs (Minswap, Splash, SundaeSwap, WingRiders, CSWAP, MuesliSwap), lending and credit (Liqwid Finance, Surf Lending, Dano Finance), and synthetics/CDP (Indigo). Every dashboard updates daily through the same automated pipeline used for the core Cardano dataset and applies Token Terminal's standardized Layer 1 methodology, so the metrics are directly comparable with applications on other chains.
